# Vendored third-party code

| File | Source | Licence | Verified |
|---|---|---|---|
| `jsQR.js` | npm `jsqr@1.4.0`, `dist/jsQR.js` | Apache-2.0 | SHA-1 `ae81b7cf49a4006a3c34d2a6f703927929bba8be`. It is byte-identical to the file inside the registry tarball, whose SHA-1 `8efb8d0a7cc6863cb6d95116b9069123ce9eb2d1` matches the checksum published by npm |

Bundled rather than loaded from a CDN. Manifest V3 forbids remote code, and a pinned, verified copy can't be swapped underneath us.
